speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Model Falls

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The scale model cracks in half. Then the table cracks. Then, with the sound of a very large drawer being pulled from a very large cabinet, the walls of the castle begin to come down.
new_text: You hear the scale model split. The table cracks beneath it, and the sound travels through the castle walls.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: In the gallery a portrait slips off its hook and lands face-up. For the first time in ten years, nobody picks it up.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Facade Falls

speaker: (narration)
current_text: In the Showcase Quarter a painted door falls flat, and a very surprised citizen steps through it onto a very real street.
new_text: In {showcase}, a painted door falls flat. You see a citizen step through onto the street beyond.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Shopfronts topple. Hedges wilt into their own shapes. The loudspeakers cough once and go quiet.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Behind the facade: houses, lawns and people, all of them a bit crooked. A child paints the new sign at the gate: PATHORDIA.
new_text: Behind the facade, you see houses, lawns and people. At the gate, a child paints a new sign. You read: {pathordia}.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Rifts Close

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Across the Capital the rifts fold up like letters. In the Reek, the Sick Patch is a flower bed.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: In Grave Row, a family walks slowly to a quiet plot and stays. In the Transit Yards the wheels slow, and slow, and stop, and the crews lie in the sun.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: In the Hungry Quarter, somebody lights a stove.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Wrinkles

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Wrinkles climb up out of the Crease, blinking, into a light they had forgotten. Wren carries the true records under her arm. Nurse Hesper has brought the tea.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Fig Sly is already selling something, to somebody, for some reason. Nobody stops him.
new_text: You see Fig Sly among the people emerging from the Crease. He carries his stock with him.
writer_note: Ending tone only; vendor dialogue and all black-market functions remain untouched.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Paths Meet

speaker: (narration)
current_text: And the Paths come home. Grandmaster Flex, the Grand Chef, Agnes Overdue and Archdruid Compostella meet in the plaza and look at one another for the first time in ten years.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Beefcakes are late. The Necrocrats have brought a form. The Gourmands are overdressed. The Refusemancers smell, faintly, of compost.
new_text: You watch the four Paths gather around their leaders, carrying what they have saved from the past ten years.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Nobody agrees on anything. It is the happiest sound the Capital has ever heard.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Together

speaker: (narration)
current_text: {villain} demanded one way for everyone. It was never what made the kingdom strong.
new_text: You look from {villain}'s broken model to the people in the plaza. They have begun talking to one another.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Muscle and stoves, records and soil: each was good alone. Together they ran a kingdom, argued about it every day, and it worked.
new_text: You see hands marked by iron, flour, ink and soil reach across the space between the four groups.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The point was never to be the same. The point was the argument. Different Paths, working together.
new_text: You listen as they argue over where to begin. Nobody orders the others to be quiet.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The New Decree

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A new decree appears on the plaza wall of {pathordia}, in four different handwritings. It reads: DIFFERENT PATHS MAY MIX AGAIN.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Somebody has crossed out MAY and written SHOULD. Somebody else has crossed out SHOULD and written WILL, IF THEY FEEL LIKE IT. A pigeon sits on the full stop.
new_text: You read the changes beneath it: MAY crossed out for SHOULD, then WILL, IF THEY FEEL LIKE IT. Four hands have left their marks.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Pathwork Throne
new_text: the Pathwork Throne
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The castle does not fall. It opens. Where the Model Room floor was, a stair of four colours winds down into the old heart of the Capital.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: At the bottom stands the Pathwork Throne: four seats grown into one, four colours woven as a single thread. It was never {villain}'s.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You sit, and the Throne answers. It knows you.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Everything comes back at once: the lullaby, the glass, the throne room, the name. {prince_full}. And the Paths, all four, as they were always meant to be carried.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: {villain} Sees

speaker: (narration)
current_text: {villain} sits among the pieces of his model. As the Paths settle, he sees the kingdom as it is, and not as his reflection.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Cracked streets. Real faces. A boy he kept in a cell.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Slowly, he understands how much he broke. The wells were good. The schools were good. He made one choice for everyone, and nobody will trust him with another.
new_text: You watch him lower his eyes. Beyond the broken model, people pass the castle doors without waiting for his permission.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Agnes Overdue
current_text: File Complete

speaker: Agnes Overdue
current_text: Agnes Overdue floats up to the old transfer file, finds the heir clause and, with great ceremony, brings down her stamp: HEIR: ALIVE. FILE COMPLETE.

speaker: Agnes Overdue
current_text: Maren pushes through the crowd, tortoise-slow, and stops in front of you. There is flour on her sleeve.
new_text: You see Maren make her way through the crowd. She stops in front of you, flour still on her sleeve.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Agnes Overdue
current_text: '{prince},' she says. It is the first time anyone has said it aloud and meant it. 'Welcome home.'

speaker: (narration)
current_text: THE END (OF THE BEGINNING)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A game about a kingdom that was strong because it was not the same.

new_text: For everyone learning to choose again.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Paths will be back, in some other order.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Thank you for playing.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Paths Unbound

speaker: (narration)
current_text: With {villain} gone, the Paths are free to mix again. Your decks may now combine cards from ALL Paths, and the Alchemist's tri-Path crafting is open. What made the kingdom strong was never sameness.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Decks may now use 3 or more Paths.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Alchemist's tri-Path crafting is unlocked (no tri-Path recipes exist yet).

speaker: (narration)
current_text: {pathordia} is open to everyone: the facade is down, the rifts are sealed, and {villain} works under guard on wells and pipes, kept away from every Path.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You are back in {pathordia}. It is mostly the same streets, but it sounds quite different: people are shouting at each other cheerfully, in every direction.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Wren sits on the edge of the fountain with a ledger on her knee, writing the title of the first honest page: THE TRUE RECORD, VOLUME ONE.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Capital is free. The postgame begins: decks of three or more Paths are now allowed.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: Breathe in. Hold. ...Feel that? That is a city with nowhere it has to be.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: Rollo's crews are lying in the sun. I told them rest is a rep. They believed me. Heart and mind, son. You used both.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: The sauce is gone from every stove in the kingdom. Real onions again. I have not wept so much since I was a girl.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: You did something worth signing, you know. Now sit. Eat. Eat a mess.

speaker: Agnes Overdue
current_text: I have filed a Form of Gratitude, dear. It was approved on the first attempt. Irregular.
new_text: Thank you, dear. I have written it down, though that hardly seems enough.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Agnes Overdue
current_text: I am going to cry anyway. In triplicate.
new_text: I think I am going to cry. I have wanted to for a very long time.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Look at this crack in the marble. Something is growing out of it.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: I am going to let it. It has earned the right. So have you, child.

speaker: Primm
current_text: ...You do not even know, do you? Look at you. You have walked my castle for hours and you have not once asked why my portraits stop at eleven.

speaker: The Wanderer
current_text: ...What do you mean?

speaker: Primm
current_text: I kept your face. I kept it for ten years, in the one gallery I never let anyone clean. It is the only face I could not improve.

speaker: Primm
current_text: You are the Royal Asset. You are the boy who got out. You are {prince_full}, and you have been so very hard to find.

speaker: The Wanderer
current_text: ...That's not possible. I would remember.

speaker: Primm
current_text: Everything is possible when it is filed correctly. Your power has kept this kingdom lit for ten years. I have only been looking after it.
new_text: Your power has kept this kingdom lit for ten years. I have only been looking after it. Surely you can see that.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Primm
current_text: Come. You may as well see it used properly.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: {villain}'s Private Gallery

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A small gallery behind a mirror, which nobody is allowed to clean. A dead end with a prize.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A single portrait hangs in a gilt frame, lit like a shrine: a royal family of three.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The king and the queen have been painted over in white, so carefully that every brushstroke runs the same way. Only the boy between them was left untouched.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A small card on the frame, in a neat hand: 'KEPT FOR REFERENCE.' The boy has your face.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You stand there a long time. Your throat has closed, and you cannot say why.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Behind the frame, a hidden hatch holds a small bag. You take it, and you do not look back at the portrait, because if you do you will not be able to leave.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Correction Ward

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A long ward of white cells. Free the prisoners for a boon, and read what the Path-ologists wrote.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Path-ologists' records are pinned to every door. 'SUBJECT 1, the Royal Asset. Drain cycle 3,114.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Power stable, routed to the Throne. {villain}'s hold depends on it. Do not allow the Subject to leave.'

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You read the word Subject until it stops being a word.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The oldest notes, at the far end, are in a different hand: careful, rounded, familiar. 'Observation, Year 1. The child is not a specimen. He asks for his mother. I am leaving the lab. M.'

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You have seen that handwriting on a pie recipe.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: Do not look so alarmed. The guard is very kind, and the workshop has a very nice window.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: I am designing a water main. A real one: pipes, a pump and nothing clever. It is the first thing I have made in ten years that nobody had to agree to.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: I am not permitted to speak of the Paths, or to touch one. I find that I do not miss it. I find that I miss the wells.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: He is allowed visitors, one at a time, ten minutes, no mirrors. Those are the rules. I did not write them, and I find I do not mind them.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: He designs very good drains, it turns out. Do not tell him I said so.
new_text: He designs good drains. The guard stays here while he works.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.
